Administrative, NUTS and health codes for one choice of each vintage

Source: R/lookup.R
pt_lookup.Rd

Assembles a wide lookup table from pt_registry, pt_nuts_codes and pt_health_codes. Each axis is chosen independently, because they are independent: the same freguesia set is published by INE under more than one NUTS revision, and a NUTS revision says nothing about which freguesias exist.

Usage

pt_lookup(
  level = "freguesia",
  admin_vintage = NULL,
  nuts_vintage = NULL,
  health_vintage = NULL
)

Arguments

level

Grain of the result: "freguesia" (default), "municipio", "distrito", "nuts1", "nuts2", "nuts3", or the health levels "reg_saude", "uls", "aces", "uls_municipio", "aces_municipio". Coarser levels return one row per unit with only the columns that are constant within it. A health level reads its own health geography unless health_vintage says otherwise (see Vintages).

admin_vintage

Which administrative unit set: "2025", "2013", "2011" or "2001". Leave it out for the newest ("2025").

nuts_vintage

Which NUTS revision: "2024", "2013" or "2002". Leave it out for the newest ("2024"); NA drops the NUTS columns.

health_vintage

Which health geography: "2024" or "2022". Unlike the other two, leaving it out omits the health columns, except at a health level. ULS exist only in "2024" and ACES only in "2022", so level = "uls" with "2022" returns that geography's ACES, and level = "aces" with "2024" its ULS (likewise for the *_municipio levels), with a warning.

Value

A data.frame, one row per unit of level.

Vintages

admin_vintage selects which administrative units exist:

  • "2025" — 3259 freguesias, the current set (Lei 25-A/2025, in force from the 2025 autárquicas, which restored units aggregated in 2013).

  • "2013" — 3092 freguesias (Lei 11-A/2013). This is what INE still publishes, including on indicators labelled "NUTS - 2024".

  • "2011" — 4260 freguesias, the map the 2011 census used, in force from 2004 until the 2013 reform.

  • "2001" — 4241 freguesias, the map the 2001 census used. 22 freguesias were created and 3 dissolved between the two censuses.

The pre-2013 maps are named after the census that recorded them, because neither was made by a single law. The 1991 census used an earlier map again (4208 freguesias in 305 municípios, before Odivelas, Trofa and Vizela were created in 1998), which geopt does not have.

nuts_vintage selects the NUTS revision: "2024" (9 NUTS II, 26 NUTS III), "2013" (7 / 25) or "2002" (7 / 30).

health_vintage selects the health geography: "2024" (regiões de saúde + ULS) or "2022" (the former ARS + ACES). Health columns are omitted unless asked for, or unless level is a health level: those read the geography their units belong to, "2024" for "reg_saude", "uls" and "uls_municipio", and "2022" for "aces" and "aces_municipio".

Codes are vintage-local

A DTMNFR identifies a unit within its own vintage only. None of the 302 freguesias restored in 2025 reused its pre-2013 code, so comparing a code across vintages — or joining data of one vintage onto codes of another — silently mismatches. Use pt_crosswalk() to convert, and pt_recode() to carry values across.

See also

pt_registry, pt_nuts_codes, pt_health_codes, pt_crosswalk(), pt_match()

Examples

head(pt_lookup())
#>   dtmnfr                                         freguesia
#> 1 010103                                    Aguada de Cima
#> 2 010109                                       Fermentelos
#> 3 010112                                Macinhata do Vouga
#> 4 010119                                  Valongo do Vouga
#> 5 010124      União das freguesias de Recardães e Espinhel
#> 6 010125 União das freguesias de Travassô e Óis da Ribeira
#>     designacao_simplificada dtmn municipio dt distrito_ilha nuts1_cod
#> 1            Aguada de Cima 0101    Águeda 01        Aveiro       PT1
#> 2               Fermentelos 0101    Águeda 01        Aveiro       PT1
#> 3        Macinhata do Vouga 0101    Águeda 01        Aveiro       PT1
#> 4          Valongo do Vouga 0101    Águeda 01        Aveiro       PT1
#> 5      Recardães e Espinhel 0101    Águeda 01        Aveiro       PT1
#> 6 Travassô e Óis da Ribeira 0101    Águeda 01        Aveiro       PT1
#>        nuts1 nuts2_cod  nuts2 nuts3_cod            nuts3
#> 1 Continente      PT19 Centro     PT191 Região de Aveiro
#> 2 Continente      PT19 Centro     PT191 Região de Aveiro
#> 3 Continente      PT19 Centro     PT191 Região de Aveiro
#> 4 Continente      PT19 Centro     PT191 Região de Aveiro
#> 5 Continente      PT19 Centro     PT191 Região de Aveiro
#> 6 Continente      PT19 Centro     PT191 Região de Aveiro

# the combination INE actually publishes: 2013 freguesias, 2024 NUTS
head(pt_lookup(admin_vintage = "2013", nuts_vintage = "2024"))
